crew_tilt_stacked_on_production.plain_summary: Once the week's referees are announced, nudge the pick against a run-heavy home team drawing a holding-happy crew, and toward a big home underdog drawing a flag-happy one. On six past seasons that changed 15 picks and gained about a third of a point of accuracy on top of the card we actually play.
